REASON FOR VISIT: Follow-up for asthma management, 1 month after inhaler adjustment.

INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient reports fewer nighttime symptoms, uses rescue inhaler about once weekly, no ED visits.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Lungs clear to auscultation, no wheeze, no accessory muscle use, no distress.

ASSESSMENT: Asthma, improved control on current regimen.
